title: Notice regarding non availability of Hon'ble Mr. Justice Bhargav D. Karia and Hon'ble Mr. Justice Nirzar S. Desai on 06.10.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 06/10/2026
It is hereby notified that on 06.10.2026;

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 06/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-03/2026
It is hereby notified that on 06.10.2026;
(1) Hon’ble Mr. Justice Bhargav D. Karia would not be available for
Judicial as well as Administrative work.
(2) Hon’ble Mr. Justice Nirzar S. Desai would not be available.
(3) Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Ms. Justice Sangeeta K.
Vishen and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Utkarsh Thakorbhai Desai)
would take up the matters notified in the Cause list of
Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice Bhargav D. Karia
and Hon’ble Mr. Justice Nirzar S. Desai.)
By Order
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
